hero.intro: I build and scale web platforms, distributed microservices and event-driven systems in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and AWS — plus AI automation and agentic AI services in Python and FastAPI, and Solidity smart contracts across Ethereum and Solana. Currently leading 4–6 engineers on real-time AI and Web3 products used across global contact centers.

stats.label: Building and scaling production web platforms
Latency cut by re-architecting to event-driven services
Feature delivery via AI-assisted development workflows

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer
points: Lead 4–6 engineers building real-time AI and Web3 platforms used across global contact centers.
Re-architected the core backend into event-driven microservices (Node.js, RabbitMQ, Redis) — p95 latency down 25–30% while absorbing several-fold traffic growth without proportional cost.
Drove team-wide adoption of AI-assisted development, automating boilerplate, scaffolding and test generation to cut delivery time an estimated 30–40%.
Led a zero-downtime MongoDB → PostgreSQL migration with dual writes and background backfill — no customer-facing interruption.

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer
points: Developed backend services in Node.js and NestJS across REST and GraphQL, favouring modular, maintainable architectures.
Integrated GraphQL data layers to reduce over-fetching and streamline frontend–backend communication.
